operations.description: Returns toestanden/versions sorted latest → oldest by validFrom. Use from/to (YYYY-MM-DD) to window by validFrom; limit/offset to page. Each item carries the rendered consolidated PDF plus its bijlage attachments.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Page size (default: all remaining after offset)

parameters.name: from
parameters.description: Inclusive lower bound on validFrom (YYYY-MM-DD). Items with null validFrom are excluded when set.

parameters.name: to
parameters.description: Inclusive upper bound on validFrom (YYYY-MM-DD). Items with null validFrom are excluded when set.

CvdrVersionsResponse.description: Available versions (toestanden) of a CVDR regulation

total.description: Total toestand count after from/to filtering, before paging

count.description: Number of items in this response after paging

items.description: Toestanden, sorted latest → oldest by validFrom

CvdrVersionItem.description: A single version (toestand) of a CVDR regulation

version.description: Manifest expression label — pass as the ?version= parameter on /text, /toc, /parts

validTo.description: Version valid to date (null if open-ended; read-time clamped if upstream interval is inverted)

validFromEstimated.description: True when validFrom was derived/estimated rather than declared verbatim

validFromSource.description: Provenance of validFrom (which source/field it was taken from)

url.description: Canonical portal URL for this toestand (display only)

textUrl.description: cdx-nl:// URL to fetch this version's text

pdf.description: Rendered consolidated PDF for this toestand; null when none

bijlagen.description: Bijlage (annex) PDF attachments for this toestand — empty list if none

CvdrAttachmentRef.description: Reference to a CVDR attachment (consolidated PDF or bijlage)
